corrections: Native WebKit Tab skips ordinary buttons under this test environment; a paired native test chooses Option-Tab for full-control traversal. Component arrow behavior remains unchanged.

The removed Breadcrumb maps were borrowed by Command Menu input styling. Its page-stack actions now compose Group/Button; the input mapping no longer depends on the retired chip interface. Existing Command Menu tests pass; its complete N08 rebuild remains pending.

A Playwright locator starting at the shadow toolbar root did not traverse its assigned light-DOM controls. The documentation fixture now scopes through the component host and verifies the named owner.

The 360px documentation page expanded to 580px because API tables lacked overflow containers. Removing only those tables restored 360px; named, focusable scroll regions fix the source generator without hiding page content.
limits: Actual Safari/OS keyboard preferences and assistive-technology interaction remain M22/M26.
Dialog-specific App Bar composition must be rechecked with the new public Dialog during its M17 slice.
Remaining M15 work is Command Menu; bring the public Dialog/Alert Dialog dependency forward first.
The final M26 orphan-token audit includes the unused topbar-h token; no old component alias remains.
